a0_in_process_baseline.detail: The retained InprocServer32 media source activates inside the Windows Camera Frame Server svchost process. M2 measured this baseline at 33.569ms producer-owned p95 and 33.428ms source-owned p95, both above the 33.3ms gate.

a1_local_server.detail: The virtual-camera IMFActivate path did not resolve a LocalServer32 class factory; no media source or first frame was activated.

a2_com_surrogate.detail: Adding AppID/DllSurrogate did not change the virtual-camera activation topology. COM still loaded the InprocServer32 media source into the Frame Server svchost process, so the surrogate candidate did not activate and does not advance to the 1000-frame gate.

conditional_checks.automated_1000_frame: not-run; neither A1 nor A2 established the candidate activation topology

verdict: A1 and A2 are NO-GO. The Windows virtual-camera activation path accepted the registered InprocServer32 source only: LocalServer32 returned REGDB_E_CLASSNOTREG, while DllSurrogate was ignored and the source remained in Frame Server svchost.exe.
